title: Divisibility Checker
description: Test any integer for divisibility by 2 through 12, each with its classic rule explained.
howto: Read the yes/no verdict and the rule used for each divisor 2–12.

faqs.a: Add the digits — if the sum is divisible by 3, so is the number. Same idea works for 9.
Alternately add and subtract the digits; if the result is a multiple of 11 (including 0), the number is divisible by 11.
6 = 2×3 and 12 = 3×4 with coprime factors, so passing both smaller tests guarantees the larger one.
